items.label: Figure 1
items.caption:
Figure 1: The previous method overlooked the embedding
of spatial information in deeper layers of the backbone net-
work during feature extraction, leading to spatial semantic
inconsistencies. Our method aims to transfer shallow spa-
tial location information into deeper layers of the network
during the feature extraction process, thereby enhancing the
expression of semantic information.

items.label: Figure 2
items.caption:
Figure 2: Our FBRT-YOLO is compared with other real-
time detectors in terms of accuracy and efficiency on Vis-
Drone dataset. The radius of the circle represents GFLOPs.

items.label: Figure 3
items.caption:
Figure 3: Framework of FBRT-YOLO. FCM module is embedded into each stage of the backbone network to integrate spatial
positional information into deeper semantic information. In the final (fourth) stage of the backbone network, MKP units are
introduced along with multi-scale convolutions to enhance perception of targets at various scales. It’s worth noting that MKP
replaces the final downsampling layer while also reducing the corresponding detection heads.
